data.description:
Implement `plugins/dso/scripts/validate-ack-rationale.sh` to make the T1 tests pass, then clean the RED marker.

## Testing Mode: GREEN

Depends on: T1 (5641-086b-9ce0-4a22)

## Files to Modify

- CREATE `plugins/dso/scripts/validate-ack-rationale.sh` (executable)
- MODIFY `.test-index` (remove RED marker for validate-ack-rationale)

## Interface

```
validate-ack-rationale.sh <rationale_text> <precondition_text>
```

Exit codes:
- 0: rationale is valid
- 1: rationale is invalid (print specific error to stderr)
- 2: precondition_text contains non-Latin characters (print to stderr: "MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: precondition text contains non-Latin characters; ack must be reviewed by a human before acceptance")

## Validation Logic

1. Trim whitespace from rationale_text. If empty after trim → exit 1 with "rationale must not be empty"
2. If length of trimmed rationale < 10 → exit 1 with "rationale must be at least 10 characters (got N)"
3. Non-Latin detection: if precondition_text contains any Unicode codepoint > 0x7F → exit 2 with MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED message. Detection via python3: `python3 -c "import sys; exit(0 if all(ord(c)<=127 for c in sys.argv[1]) else 1)" "$precondition_text"`; if python3 exits 1 → the precondition has non-Latin chars → this script exits 2.
4. 3-word-window fuzzy match:
   - Split precondition_text on whitespace to get word array: words=(implementation plan must be complete)
   - For each consecutive window of 3 words: ["implementation plan must", "plan must be", "must be complete"]
   - Normalize each window: strip non-alphanumeric, lowercase, concatenate → "implementationplanmust", "planmustbe", "mustbecomplete"
   - Normalize rationale_text the same way: strip non-alphanumeric, lowercase, concatenate
   - Check if any normalized window is a substring of normalized(rationale_text)
   - If any match → exit 0
   - If no match after all windows → exit 1 with "rationale does not reference precondition content (no 3-word window match found)"
   - Edge case: if precondition_text has fewer than 3 words → skip window check, proceed to exit 0 (cannot form a window)

Normalization function (pure bash, mirrors fuzzy-match.sh):
```bash
_normalize() {
    local s="${1,,}"  # lowercase
    local result=""
    local i c
    for (( i=0; i<${#s}; i++ )); do
        c="${s:i:1}"
        [[ "$c" == [a-z0-9] ]] && result+="$c"
    done
    echo "$result"
}
```

## .test-index RED Marker Cleanup

Remove the line added by T1:
```
plugins/dso/scripts/validate-ack-rationale.sh:tests/scripts/test-validate-ack-rationale.sh [...]
```
Use sed or python3 to remove it.
